comparison.objective: Wipe an entire monitor lead once from the plug end toward the clip end without backtracking.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch-wipe a free cable while the other hand tensions it, switch roles, and wipe both end bodies outward.
comparison.success_condition: All required regions are wiped in the permitted directions with no prohibited reverse pass; lead is released on the drape.
comparison.reason: Directional wiping and taut-cable role switching do not test precision mating, sliding transfer, or containment of an uncaged bearing mechanism. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
